description: This file defines the Lease struct and related methods for managing leases in etcd, including expiration, TTL, and associated keys.

classes.name: Lease
classes.description: Represents a lease with expiration, TTL, and associated keys.

classes.name: LeaseItem
classes.description: Represents an item/key attached to a lease.

classes.name: leasesByExpiry
classes.description: Implements sort.Interface for sorting leases by expiration time.

methods.name: NewLease
methods.description: Creates a new Lease instance with specified ID and TTL.

methods.name: expired
methods.description: Checks if the lease has expired based on remaining TTL.

methods.name: persistTo
methods.description: Persists the lease data to the backend storage.

methods.name: TTL
methods.description: Returns the TTL of the lease.

methods.name: SetLeaseItem
methods.description: Associates a key/item with the lease in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: getRemainingTTL
methods.description: Returns the last checkpointed remaining TTL of the lease.

methods.name: forever
methods.description: Sets the lease to never expire.

methods.name: Demoted
methods.description: Checks if the lease's expiry has been reset to forever.

methods.name: Keys
methods.description: Returns all keys attached to the lease.

methods.name: Remaining
methods.description: Returns the remaining duration before the lease expires.
